_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest), judged by eye from the figures. 1: a simple shape among few, plain options; 2: a short line shape in options with a few lines; 3: a short shape among many crossing lines; 4: a shape with several bends hidden in a dense tangle. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
